label: ABC4_cF24_216_a_b_e-001
title: High-Temperature Cubic KClO$_{4}$ ($H0_{5}$) Structure
comments:
This is the high-temperature phase of the listed perchlorate structures. KClO$_{4}$ transforms from its \href{current_web_home_dir/AB4C_oP24_62_c_2cd_c-001}{ground-state orthorhombic structure, $H0_{2}$} into this structure at $299.5^{\circ}$C. The transition temperature for the other compounds range from $155^{\circ}$C (AgClO$_{4}$) to $308^{\circ}$C (NaClO$_{4}$). 
 The ICSD lists BaSO$_{4}$ as the structure type, but we prefer KClO$_{4}$ for the prototype as it has a {\em Strukturbericht} symbol, and use BaSO$_{4}$ as the prototype for the \href{current_web_home_dir/AB4C_oP24_62_c_2cd_c-001}{orthorhombic $H0_{2}$ structure}. 
 The lattice constant for KClO$_{4}$ was measured at $310^{\circ}$C. 
 Previous versions of this page listed EuPtIn$_{4}$ and MgSnCu$_{4}$ under this prototype. This is incorrect, the atoms are on (4a), (4c) and (16e) sites and so belong to the \href{current_web_home_dir/A4BC_cF24_216_e_a_c-001}{Cu$_{4}$SnMg prototype}.
